messages:
Alex (author): quick heads-up — can I get runtime + platform + infra + security eyes on PR #10014? Small change to KV cache fallback behavior that touches runtime routing + adds env var KVCACHE_FALLBACK_MODE. Hoping to merge in tomorrow 10:00 PST canary window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/10014
Priya: I can pick up the runtime review this afternoon. Any perf numbers or known regressions?
Alex (author): perf: local quick runs show ~<5% p99 increase for 2–4k sequences, CI mostly green except one long-seq flake. No model quality regressions observed in smoke prompts. Quick snippet to repro local: ```export KVCACHE_FALLBACK_MODE=shallow && ./bin/runtime --run-e2e --model redwood-7b```
Jake: Platform: we need a rollout plan and metrics for fallback hits. Also confirm console flags + manifest changes. @Sam (oncall) does adding the env require any infra migration?
Sam (oncall): infra note: env var itself is fine. We do need a SIG-based eviction header in the deployment manifest and an annotation for safer rollback (infra.redwood/rollback=true). I can patch the manifest once approvals land. If someone posts 'infra-approve' I'll take it.
Robin (security): Security checklist: any new logging of request payloads/tokens? telemetry changes? If no, we can do an expedited review. Need repro steps & CI link.
Alex (author): no token/log changes, telemetry unchanged. Repro & CI: ```./scripts/e2e_kv_fallback.sh --model=redwood-7b``` CI: https://ci.redwood/10014/status
CI-Bot: CI status: runtime-unit ✅, integration ✅, longseq-integration ❗ (flake) — rerun queued.
Priya: I'll do runtime code + KV cache sanity tests. ETA ~3h. If I see anything odd I'll tag platform.
Robin (security): I'll unblock after Priya gives a thumbs if there's no new sensitive data paths. Expect ~1h after runtime-approve to finish inline comments.
Jake: For rollout propose: 5% for 2h -> 25% for 4h -> full. Need a metric fallback_hits and an alert if fallback rate > 10% for 1h. Adding metric is small; will follow up with a PR to telemetry.
Alex (author): thanks. plan: Priya runtime-approve -> Robin sec-approve -> then tag infra-approve so Sam can add manifest annotation and we merge. @Sam prefer me to tag or will you watch?
Sam (oncall): I'll watch. If you post 'infra-approve' I'll merge the manifest patch. If not, ping me 15m before the merge window and I'll be ready.
Alex (author): I'll update PR labels (runtime-reviewed, security-pending) and add canary config in the description.
CI-Bot: Rerun complete: all checks green (flake resolved).
Priya: runtime-approve — left a tiny nit on var name, but behavior looks good, no perf regression in my quick tests.
Robin (security): sec-approve — no secrets or new telemetry. Left one inline wording suggestion.
Alex (author): awesome, thank you all. Next steps: Jake adds metric PR, Sam adds manifest patch after infra-approve. Target merge 10:00 PST tomorrow. I'll post final merge ping 15m prior.
Jake: noted — I'll open the metric PR with a dashboard link.
Sam (oncall): I'll stand by for 'infra-approve' or your ping, Alex.
Alex (author): posting infra-approve now and adding final label. Thanks everyone :rocket:
